newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - H&M pre-tax profit 1.85 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - H&M pre-tax profit 1.85 bln SKR.

text.p: Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz (H&M) was expected to post a pre-tax profit of 1.85 billion crown for the year 1995/96 compared to 1.32 billion crowns a year ago, a Reuters poll of 14 analysts founds.
Forecasts for the year ended November 30, 1996, varied between 1.68 and 2.00 billion crowns.
The dividend is expected to be 9.30 crowns for 1995/96 compared to 7.75 crowns a year earlier.
H&M's result for 1996/97 was expected to rise further to 2.28 billion crowns. Forecasts ranged between 2.10 and 2.46 billion crowns.
H&M will release its annual earnings report on January 30.

Analysts interviewed for the survey were from Carnegie, Enskilda, Fiba, Goldman Sachs, James Capel, Handelsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Grenfell, Nordiska, Penser, SBC Warburg, and Swedbank.
